verdict.rationale: Ramp documents OAuth 2.0 scopes in a `resource:permission` pattern, recommends least privilege ("configure only the scopes your app needs"), and supports client-credentials auth for standalone agents through `ramp agent login`. Its agent-identity model promises "one key per agent" tied to a human sponsor, with flexible per-agent permissions, and adds expiring sessions plus role-based MCP restrictions. A live probe confirms the MCP server is OAuth-gated and publishes granular read/write scopes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of actually issuing a narrowly scoped per-agent key, beyond vendor docs and scope-metadata probes.
